after.title: Cellular and torsion recipients

after.title: Localization at the realization kernel

before.title: Follow the ordinary source unit
before.summary: Read the critical witness together with its native hypotheses, then the full unit model and the source localization. Finish with the remaining local-unit comparison. This is an editorial order, not a mathematical dependency chain.

stages.label: A perfect source for the universal vacuum
stages.description: At critical level, \(E=Y_0\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{U(\mathfrak g)}\mathbb C\) is perfect and has cohomology in nonnegative internal weights. Under the native comparison hypotheses, its actual realization is the universal vacuum \(V\), and \(V\) belongs to \(\operatorname{thick}(W)\). The actual supported unit lifts the homogeneous vacuum extensions to \(E\) and preserves their finite products.

stages.label: The ordinary global unit fails at critical level
stages.description: For every nonzero simple complex \(\mathfrak g\) at affine level \(\mu=-h\), put \(E=Y_0\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{U(\mathfrak g)}\mathbb C\). The ordinary algebraic telescope \(L=\operatorname*{hocolim}_{r\ge0}E[r]\langle-r(r+3)/2\rangle\), using the lifted quadratic-jet extensions, is nonzero and has \(\Phi(L)=0\). Its actual unit is \(L\to0\) with nonzero cone \(L[1]\). This holds graded and ungraded under the stated native hypotheses.

stages.label: Compactness fails inside the generated recipient
stages.description: At the same critical levels, \(X=\bigoplus_{r\ge0}V[r]\langle-r(r+3)/2\rangle\) admits the actual map \((1-\sigma)^{-1}j_0:V\to X\) with a nonzero projection to every summand, where \(\sigma\) sends each summand to the next by its shifted vacuum extension and \(j_0\) includes the first summand. Thus \(V\) and \(W\) are not compact inside \(\operatorname{Loc}(W)\) ungraded, and inside the category generated by every energy shift of \(W\) when graded.

stages.label: A model of the actual unit on every ordinary input
stages.description: Under the native hypotheses, a strict smooth right-\(R\) model \(Q\) representing \(W\) with its supplied marked native action, a semifree resolution \(F\to L\), and a genuine smooth \(K\)-injective replacement \(j:Q\otimes_R F\to J\) give the full Hom model \(\operatorname{Hom}_A(Q,J)\) of \(\Psi\Phi(L)\). The signed map \(l\mapsto(q\mapsto(-1)^{|q||l|}j(q\otimes l))\) is the actual unit for every unbounded \(L\).

stages.label: The exact defect of passing from finite cells to the full source
stages.description: The actual unit is invertible on perfect \(R\)-modules. For any finite-cell presentation \(F=\operatorname*{colim}_T F_T\), its cone is the tensor–Hom interchange defect. In every degree \(n\) and weight \(w\) it fits into \(0\to\operatorname{coker}\gamma^{(n,w)}\to H^n(\operatorname{Cone}\eta_L)_w\to\ker\gamma^{(n+1,w)}\to0\), where \(\gamma\) compares maps from \(W\langle w\rangle\) into the finite realized stages with maps into \(\Phi(L)\).

stages.label: An explicit localization at the algebraic realization kernel
stages.description: For \(K_P=\ker(P\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}-)\), countable semifree null generators and an explicit \(\omega_1\) evaluation-cone tower construct the exact reflector \(\lambda_P:\operatorname{D}(R)\to K_P^\perp\) on every ordinary unbounded input. Its kernel is exactly \(K_P\), and it inverts exactly the derived \(P\)-tensor equivalences, giving \(\operatorname{D}(R)/K_P\simeq K_P^\perp\).

stages.label: The actual unit factors through the source reflector
stages.description: Under the native comparison \(U\Phi\simeq P\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}-\), the algebraic kernel is \(\ker\Phi\) and every \(\Psi(M)\) is local. The actual unit factors uniquely as \(L\to\lambda_P L\xrightarrow{\beta_L}\Psi\Phi(L)\), with \(\beta_L=(\Psi\Phi(\ell_L))^{-1}\eta_{\lambda_P L}\). The adjunct of \(\beta_L\) is the inverse of \(\Phi(\ell_L)\).

stages.label: Both adjoints are conservative on the localized cellular comparison
stages.description: Under the native hypotheses, the actual adjunction restricts from \(K_P^\perp\) to the full smooth derived category with conservative left adjoint. Restricting the target to \(C_W\) makes both adjoints conservative. The source reflector is universal among exact Verdier source localizations through which \(\Phi\) factors conservatively.

stages.label: The unit defect has a kernel part and a local part
stages.description: Under the native hypotheses, \(\operatorname{Cone}(\ell_L)\to\operatorname{Cone}(\eta_L)\to\operatorname{Cone}(\beta_L)\to\operatorname{Cone}(\ell_L)[1]\) is a distinguished triangle. Its first term is \(P\)-null, its third term is local, and applying \(\lambda_P\) to the unit cone gives \(\operatorname{Cone}(\beta_L)\). For any \(P\)-null \(L\), the actual unit is \(L\to0\) and its cone is \(L[1]\).

stages.label: The remaining unit on the localized source
stages.description: The construction removes exactly the realization kernel but does not prove \(\beta_L\) invertible for every local source. An equivalence between the localized source \(K_P^\perp\) and \(C_W\) therefore remains outside this theorem, even though both adjoints are conservative.

after.title: The ordinary unit across parameter ranges
after.summary: First identify the actual unbounded adjunction. Follow the nonrational rank-one theorem through its ideal and base-unit inputs, then compare the critical and negative-level kernels. The remaining torsion-image comparison concerns a different category.

stages.label: A model of the actual unit on every ordinary input
stages.description: Under the native hypotheses, a strict smooth right-\(R\) model \(Q\) representing \(W\) with its supplied marked native action, a semifree resolution \(F\to L\), and a genuine smooth \(K\)-injective replacement \(j:Q\otimes_R F\to J\) give the full Hom model \(\operatorname{Hom}_A(Q,J)\) of \(\Psi\Phi(L)\). The signed map \(l\mapsto(q\mapsto(-1)^{|q||l|}j(q\otimes l))\) is the actual unit for every unbounded \(L\).

stages.label: Every unbounded smooth complex has an explicit injective replacement
stages.description: An actual acyclic-monomorphism cell construction iterated through \(\omega_1\) gives a strict ordinary functor \(J\) and a natural monomorphic quasi-isomorphism \(M\to J(M)\). Every term of \(J(M)\) is injective and the whole complex is K-injective, so full \(\operatorname{Hom}_A(X,J(M))\) computes ordinary smooth derived Hom for arbitrary unbounded \(X,M\).

stages.label: The actual nonrational rank-one ideal has zero derived tensor square
stages.description: For \(B=Y_{-s}\), \(\mathfrak g=\mathfrak{sl}_2\) and \(s\notin\mathbb Q\), the actual positive-weight ideal \(I=\bigoplus_{w>0}B_w\) satisfies \(I\otimes_{U(\mathfrak{sl}_2)}^{\mathbf L}I\simeq0\), retaining both outer actions in the graded and ungraded bimodule categories.

stages.label: A derived square-zero ideal reduces every source to two inflated complexes
stages.description: Let \(B\to R\) be a split augmented dg algebra, K-flat over \(R\) on both sides, with ideal \(I\) satisfying \(I\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}I=0\). For \(F=R\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}-\), inflation \(U\), and \(J=R\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}I\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}R\), every unbounded \(L\) has a natural triangle \(U(J\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}F(L))\to L\to UF(L)\). For any exact adjunction out of \(D(B)\), its actual unit is globally invertible exactly when it is invertible on every inflated \(R\)-complex.

stages.label: The actual unit is invertible on every inflated base complex
stages.description: For \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\), native \(k\notin\mathbb Q\) and raw affine level \(\ell=-k-2\), the actual native unit is an equivalence on every ordinary unbounded complex inflated from the full ghost quotient \(H=U(\mathfrak g[t^{-1}])\), hence from \(R=U(\mathfrak g)\). The signed unit evaluates at the vacuum to the identity under the genuine unbounded Shapiro comparison.

stages.label: Nonrational rank-one induction is fully faithful on the entire ordinary source
stages.description: For \(\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb C)\), native \(k\in\mathbb C\setminus\mathbb Q\) and raw affine level \(\ell=-k-2\), the actual unit \(L\to\Psi\Phi L\) is an equivalence for every ordinary unbounded \(Y_k\)-module, including nonzero ghost actions. The actual realization is fully faithful with image exactly \(\operatorname{Loc}(W)\), or \(\operatorname{Loc}\{W\langle w\rangle:w\in\mathbb Z\}\) in the graded convention.

stages.label: The actual counit is the cellular approximation at nonrational rank one
stages.description: Under the same nonrational \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) native hypotheses, \(W\) and its required internal shifts are compact within the generated image. For every unrestricted smooth target \(M\), the actual counit \(\Phi\Psi M\to M\) is canonically the cellular-coreflector map \(\operatorname{Cell}_W M\to M\); it is invertible exactly on that image.

stages.label: The ordinary global unit fails at critical level
stages.description: For every nonzero simple complex \(\mathfrak g\) at affine level \(\mu=-h\), put \(E=Y_0\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{U(\mathfrak g)}\mathbb C\). The ordinary algebraic telescope \(L=\operatorname*{hocolim}_{r\ge0}E[r]\langle-r(r+3)/2\rangle\), using the lifted quadratic-jet extensions, is nonzero and has \(\Phi(L)=0\). Its actual unit is \(L\to0\) with nonzero cone \(L[1]\). This holds graded and ungraded under the stated native hypotheses.

stages.label: The ordinary unit fails at every integral affine level at most minus four
stages.description: For \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) at raw affine level \(-p-2\), \(p\ge2\), a telescope of perfect Verma preimages gives \(L_p\ne0\) with \(\Phi_pL_p=0\). The actual ordinary unit is \(L_p\to0\), with nonzero cone \(L_p[1]\). An infinite-projection map entirely within the generated recipient also proves that \(W_p\) is not compact there.

stages.label: Every simple type has a noncritical unit kernel at a specified level
stages.description: For every nonzero simple complex \(\mathfrak g\) at raw affine level \(-2h^\vee\), an explicit affine-Weyl ascent chain gives an ordinary line telescope \(L\ne0\) with \(\Phi L=0\). Its actual unit has cone \(L[1]\ne0\). The same construction proves failure of compactness of \(W\) within its own localizing image.

stages.label: The remaining level ranges for the ordinary global unit
stages.description: The full ordinary unit is invertible for nonrational \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) parameters under the native hypotheses. It fails at raw \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) levels \(-4,-5,\ldots\), and at raw level \(-2h^\vee\) in every simple type. A classification at the remaining rational rank-one parameters and in other higher-rank noncritical ranges remains open.

after.note: This is an editorial reading order; mathematical dependencies are listed separately.

before.title: Corrected algebraic induction is an equivalence at every level
before.text: For every finite-dimensional simple complex Lie algebra and every level, including critical level, corrected induction gives the full unbounded enhanced equivalence after exactly the induction-detected class \(W_F\) is inverted. Restricted twisted coinduction supplies the inverse, dg adjunction, unit, counit and triangle identities on the termwise-smooth source with ordinary direct-sum tensors. \(W_F\) is a proper subclass of ordinary line-module quasi-isomorphisms. The separate first-kind unit now has an actual full \(\operatorname{Hom}\) model on every ordinary unbounded input under the stated coherent native-action and tensor–\(\operatorname{Hom}\) hypotheses. At simple critical level, the coherent native-action and tensor–\(\operatorname{Hom}\) hypotheses, together with the actual unit and full smooth/algebraic comparison on the common-lower-energy subcategories give a nonzero ordinary telescope with zero smooth realization, so that global unit fails. The marked all-energy, completed-energy and geometric fusion comparisons keep their own carriers and weak classes. Localization at the realization kernel and the exact cellular approximation are constructed; the local unit is not known to be invertible on every local source.

after.title: Corrected algebraic induction is an equivalence at every level
after.text: For every finite-dimensional simple complex Lie algebra and every level, including critical level, algebraic induction gives the full unbounded enhanced equivalence after exactly its induction-detected class \(W_F\) is inverted. Restricted twisted coinduction supplies the inverse and marked adjunction; \(W_F\) is a proper subclass of ordinary line-module quasi-isomorphisms. The separate ordinary first-kind adjunction has a full Hom model under its specified native hypotheses. For nonrational \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) parameters its actual unit is invertible on every ordinary unbounded source, and its image is exactly the category generated by the regular-top object \(W\). Under the coherent native-action and actual adjunction inputs, together with the actual unit and full smooth/algebraic comparison on common-lower-energy subcategories, critical and specified negative levels have explicit nonzero sources with zero realization. The marked all-energy, completed-energy and geometric fusion comparisons retain their own carriers and weak classes.

before.title: Induction preserves the marked comparison in every energy
before.text: For every finite-dimensional simple complex Lie algebra, every level and every finite horizontal top, the actual contragredient object and its normalized marked arrow are identified in every energy. At raw level zero the vacuum arrow has rank one, and its entire cone is computed. The full induction null class is the explicit thick, direct-sum-closed class generated by exact totalizations and ghost-zero inflated acyclic smooth current modules. The original unbounded equivalence retains its prescribed localization. The ordinary first-kind adjunction has its own full \(\operatorname{Hom}\) model under the stated native hypotheses, with critical global unit failure under the additional actual-unit and full smooth/algebraic comparison on common-lower-energy subcategories, and a remaining local-unit comparison. The completed-energy equivalence also has a different carrier and weak class.

after.title: Induction preserves the marked comparison in every energy
after.text: For every finite-dimensional simple complex Lie algebra, every level and every finite horizontal top, the actual contragredient object and normalized marked arrow are identified in every energy. At raw level zero the vacuum arrow has rank one and its entire cone is computed. The full algebraic induction null class is the explicit thick, direct-sum-closed class generated by exact totalizations and ghost-zero inflated acyclic smooth current modules. The separate ordinary first-kind unit is globally invertible at nonrational rank-one parameters under its native hypotheses, while critical and specified negative levels admit unit kernels under the coherent native action, actual adjunction, and actual-unit/full smooth-algebraic comparison on common-lower-energy subcategories. The completed-energy equivalence uses a different carrier and weak class.

before.title: Completed induction has its own support theorem
before.text: The complete induction equivalence uses degreewise products of discrete energy fibres, continuous module maps and separate degreewise lower energy bounds and, for every \(\epsilon>0\), a bound \(e\ge L_\epsilon-\epsilon q^2\) for \(q\ge0\), with no negative-tail growth bound. Its actual unit and counit are continuous vector-complex deformation equivalences. Ordinary quasi-isomorphisms lie in its detected weak class, strictly at every simple critical level; equality holds in the specified energy-preserving and termwise bounded-above cases. This differs from the original algebraic induction theorem, whose detected class is strictly smaller than ordinary quasi-isomorphisms. The earlier bounded first-kind roof retains its native hypotheses, common termwise lower energy bound and finite cohomology fibres. A separate full ordinary unbounded unit model is now constructed under the specified coherent native-action and tensor–\(\operatorname{Hom}\) assumptions. With the additional actual-unit and full smooth/algebraic comparison on common-lower-energy subcategories, it has critical global unit failure. It also has an exact cellular coreflector and localization at its realization kernel, with the remaining local-unit equivalence unproved.

after.title: Completed induction has its own support theorem
after.text: The complete induction equivalence uses degreewise products of discrete energy fibres, continuous module maps, separate degreewise lower energy bounds and, for every \(\varepsilon>0\), a bound \(e\ge L_\varepsilon-\varepsilon q^2\) for \(q\ge0\), with no negative-tail growth bound. Its actual unit and counit are continuous vector-complex deformation equivalences. Ordinary quasi-isomorphisms lie in its detected weak class, strictly at every simple critical level; equality holds in the specified energy-preserving and termwise bounded-above cases. The original algebraic induction theorem has a detected class strictly smaller than ordinary quasi-isomorphisms. The separate ordinary first-kind adjunction has a full unbounded model, a nonrational rank-one equivalence with its cellular image under native hypotheses, and critical and specified negative-level unit kernels under the coherent native action, actual adjunction, and actual-unit/full smooth-algebraic comparison on common-lower-energy subcategories. These ordinary results do not replace the completed carrier or its support condition.

before.title: From a computed source to the genuine action question
before.summary: An editorial route through the distinctions between a complete source calculation, detected multigenerator factors and the separate genuine Heisenberg comparison.

stages.label: The complete one-generator source space and the actual polynomial map
stages.description: For every ordinary algebraic, possibly unbounded dg vertex target \(B\), the degree-one exterior source satisfies \(\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(\Lambda(\epsilon),B)\simeq Z^1((B\otimes\Omega_\bullet)^{hT})\). Its components are \(H^1(B^{hT})\), and its based \(n\)-th homotopy group is \(H^{1-n}(B^{hT})\). The previously constructed polynomial map \(\nu\) is itself an equivalence for target \(\Lambda(\epsilon)\), giving \(\mathbb C^2_{\rm disc}\times K(\mathbb C,1)\). Its original composition law is retained: \((\lambda,\beta,\omega)\star(\lambda',\beta',\omega')=(\lambda\lambda',\lambda'\beta+\beta',\lambda'\omega+\omega')\), with the rightmost map applied first. The conditional quartet comparison and the vanishing scalar singular-product detector retain their stated scopes. The source calculation does not identify the genuine Heisenberg actor map \(q_B\).

stages.label: One exterior generator is computed in every odd degree
stages.description: Let \(d\) be any odd integer, including a negative one, and let \(\Lambda(\epsilon_d)\) have \(|\epsilon_d|=d\) and \(d\epsilon_d=T\epsilon_d=0\). For every ordinary algebraic dg vertex algebra \(B\), unbounded in either direction if desired, \[\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(\Lambda(\epsilon_d),B)\simeq Z^d(B^{hT}\otimes\Omega_\bullet).\] Hence \(\pi_0=H^d(B^{hT})\) and \(\pi_n=H^{d-n}(B^{hT})\) at every basepoint. Here \((B^{hT})^j=B^j\oplus B^{j-1}\), with differential \((\partial b,Tb-\partial b')\). No connectivity, commutativity or target arity grading is assumed.

stages.label: Finite exterior sources have detected components and loops
stages.description: For \(A_r=\Lambda(\epsilon_1,\ldots,\epsilon_r)\), finite \(r\ge1\), all generators in degree one with \(d=T=0\), let \(B\) be a commutative dg vertex algebra strictly concentrated in nonnegative degrees. Put \(M_B=Z^1((B\otimes\Omega_\bullet)^{hT})\) and \(H_B=Z^0(B)\cap\ker T\). The actual map \[M_B^r\times(H_B)_{\rm disc}^{\binom r2}\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(A_r,B)\] has a natural homotopy left inverse. For \(B=\mathbb C\), its detected components are \(V^*\oplus\Lambda^2V^*\) and loops are \(V^*\), where \(V\) is spanned by the exterior generators. Alternation and basis changes agree with those invariants. The theorem gives a retract, not exhaustion of the full mapping space.

stages.label: Two generators split off an additive scalar factor
stages.description: The derived enveloping adjunction identifies the scalar mapping space from two degree-one exterior generators with its full dg Lie conformal mapping space. The detected \(\mathbb C^3_{\rm disc}\times K(\mathbb C^2,1)\) factor splits additively, giving a product with the homotopy fibre over zero of the actual retraction. That complementary factor is uncomputed. The positive-arity conformal cochain calculation is valid as a calculation, but no equivalence from it to all derived roofs has been proved.

stages.label: Every genuine loop detector has scalar image
stages.description: At every point \(\alpha\) of the genuine unit fibre \(\mathscr F_A(B)\), with its specified unit homotopy retained, the state-complex loop detector has exactly \(\operatorname{im}\chi_\alpha=\mathbb C\,\mathrm{id}_{U(A)}\). The actual loops \(\epsilon\mapsto\epsilon+\mu\,ds\) give an additive central section, compatible with basepoint transport, and an isomorphism of groups \[\pi_1(\mathscr F_A(B),\alpha)\cong\mathbb C_{\mathrm{add}}\times\ker\chi_\alpha.\] The kernel is not proved abelian or zero. At the displayed \(q_B\) points, this scalar factor already comes from the source. On a chosen component, the scalar-detector fibre \(\Phi_\alpha\) is connected, with \(\pi_1(\Phi_\alpha)=\ker\chi_\alpha\) and \(\pi_n(\Phi_\alpha)=\pi_n(\mathscr F_A(B),\alpha)\) for \(n\ge2\); these groups and contractibility remain open. Strict sphere roofs retain their comparison paths: forgetting those paths gives free-sphere orbits, conjugacy classes in degree one. If the required primitive map extends after refinement to an \(f^{\prime}\)-derivation \(E\) with \(Ed=D\), the sufficient pointed nullhomotopy is \[G=f^{\prime}+\theta_n(1-s)D-ds\,\theta_nE.\] The negative final term is necessary in even degree as well. The proved binary vanishing is \(E_0(x_{1(m)}x_2)=0\) for closed degree-one inputs on every kernel-loop roof, for all \(m\). It does not cover arbitrary binary relations with nonclosed inputs or prove that \(E\) exists. The full source-image comparison, completeness of \((\operatorname{ch},\operatorname{ct})\), \(q_B\), base transitions and \(\lambda_B\) remain open.

stages.label: Full base change and the genuine centre comparison
stages.description: For the nonzero-level Heisenberg algebra \(A\), determine whether the required base transitions of the full two-legged cocycle categories induce nerve weak equivalences, with every original source refinement and admissible target link retained. Every base arrow now reduces to a surjective factor. For each fixed surjective base arrow and fixed admissible target, incoming tame coverage is a sufficient criterion for the full nerve transition to be a weak equivalence; no converse is asserted. This coverage remains unproved and requires an incoming refinement whose full ideal generated by the image of the base kernel is acyclic. The genuine actor comparison \(q_B\), with its specified unit homotopy, remains separate, as do the full nilpotent inclusion and the strict-coslice to infinity-undercategory comparison.

before.title: Why finite bounds and exact interpolation must be separated
before.summary: An editorial route from the exact low-charge results through the fixed-bound counterexample and the different no-residue theorem, then to the actual conditional tensor-source comparison.

stages.label: Matched residue complexes are exact in the proved ranges
stages.description: For the algebraic residue complex \(D(r;q)\) with its prescribed matched finite bounds, whole polynomial spectator base and positive odd \(\mu\), restricted correlation duality and the normalized de Rham-plus-left-residue differential hold. Charge two is acyclic for every number of spectators; one spectator is exact in every charge at least two; charge one retains only its spectator coefficient module. At the matched one-step bounds, \(H^0(D)=H^1(D)=0\) for charges at least two. Repeated colours require finite stabilizer invariants, and the state degree is \(\sum_j|c_j|+q-n\). The separate cellular top-two theorem retains its charge and arity qualifications.

stages.label: Two spectators already defeat universal fixed-bound exactness
stages.description: In the literal matched complex, take \(r=2\), \(q=4\), \(N_{12}=0\), \(b_1=b_2=1\) and \(\mu=1\). The displayed rational cocycle gives \(H^4(D(2;4))\ne0\) at homogeneity \(-15\). Because \(n=q=4\), the proposed universal vanishing for \(n\le q\) is false for these unchanged bounds. The example is compatible with the proved low-charge and one-spectator ranges. It gives no general obstruction to enlarged bounds, cofinal systems, nonzero cellular differentials or the full centre comparison.

stages.label: Without residue cells, all charges have a two-degree amplitude
stages.description: Let \(A(r;q)\) be the sign-anti-invariant rational relative form complex with horizontal differential only, no residue cells and the original finite coefficientwise pole bounds. For all finite spectator and charge numbers, every allowed bound and positive odd \(\mu\), \(H^i(A(r;q))=0\) for \(i<q-1\). Thus only form degrees \(q-1,q\) can occur when \(q\ge1\); at charge zero only degree zero occurs. The theorem holds over the whole polynomial spectator base, including collisions. The normalized extraction \(F=EJE\) gives a primitive summand with cohomology only in degree \(q\). Raw \(E^2=0\) is false.

stages.label: Nonzero differentials can be adapted to matched locality bounds
stages.description: The cellular adaptation constructs a surjective state quasi-isomorphism with nonzero source differential, actual evaluation domination and the literal all-state relations, including \(h(d_Tc)\). The stated charge-zero, charge-one and charge-two conclusions transfer on that construction, and the stated finite-charge exact quotients are actual dg vertex quotients. An arbitrary evaluation need not annihilate the discarded higher-charge ideal. This gives genuine low-charge progress while leaving universal all-charge exact interpolation separate.

stages.label: Directed lifting gives the full mapping-space comparison
stages.description: For a small directed inverse system \(Q_i\), suppose every lifting problem against a surjective state quasi-isomorphism lifts after a later transition. Then \(\operatorname{colim}_i\operatorname{Hom}(Q_i,B\otimes\Omega_\bullet)\) is Kan and naturally equivalent to \(\operatorname{colim}_i\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(Q_i,B)\), without a simplicity assumption. Every object has an honest directed system of trivial fibrations with this property. For a specified augmentation to \(X\), identifying this space with \(\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(X,B)\) still requires the actual exact-interpolation factorizations through quasi-isomorphic objects over \(X\).

stages.label: Exact interpolation gives the full tensor-source fibre theorem
stages.description: Suppose that, for every stage of the actual system \(S_W\), a later transition factors over \(W\otimes\Lambda(\epsilon)\) through an actual state quasi-isomorphism \(Y\to W\otimes\Lambda(\epsilon)\). Then the universal fibration is equivalent, as an arrow of spaces, to \[\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(W\otimes\Lambda(\epsilon),B)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(\Lambda(\epsilon),B).\] Its homotopy fibre over \(\phi\) is \(\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(W,B^{h\delta_\phi})\) in every homotopy degree. The tensor product here is ordinary. Universal evaluation-compatible exact interpolation remains unproved.

stages.label: The remaining route must preserve evaluation through all charges
stages.description: The fixed matched-bound claim of nonnegative exactness has a counterexample; that universal claim is no longer an open target. The constructive questions concern suitably changed or cofinal models and their actual transition maps, a verified all-charge evaluation-compatible exact-interpolation property for the ordinary tensor source, and convergence for nonclosed attachments or completed recipients. No-residue amplitude and low-charge adaptation supply inputs to this route without proving its full-residue or pro consumers.

stages.description: For \(r=2\), \(b_1=b_2=1\), \(\mu=1\) and initial \(N_{12}=0\), put \(t=z_2-z_1\). stages.description: For fixed \((r,q,b,N,\mu,H_{\max})\) with \(q\ge2\), there is an effectively computable \(K\) such that increasing every spectator-pair bound by \(K\) kills cohomology in every place on the prescribed finite homogeneous range. value.title: A bare exterior E3 algebra has no coupling parameter
value.text:
A strictly unital \(E_3\)-algebra over \(\mathbb C\) with cohomology \(\Lambda(x_3)\), \(|x_3|=3\), is unique up to equivalence at the level of its bare \(E_3\) structure. That structure alone therefore supplies no varying coupling scalar. A filtration, mixed action, retained translation or central-charge class, marked comparison, or braided category is additional data.

Scope: This is single-generator exterior rigidity. It is not a rigidity theorem for arbitrary simple affine cohomology, and uniqueness does not construct an enhancement on a separately prescribed object. Rank-one coefficient Koszul comparisons retain their specified unipotent sector and separate charge grading; no full all-charge braided equivalence follows from bare formality.

value.title: The critical translation cone retains kernel and cokernel data
value.text:
For the two-term translation object \(z_{\rm top}=\operatorname{fib}(T:Z\to Z)\), its cohomology fits into \(0\to\operatorname{coker}(T:H^{n-1}Z\to H^{n-1}Z)\to H^n(z_{\rm top})\to\ker(T:H^nZ\to H^nZ)\to0\). At critical level it cannot simply be identified with the oper-form cohomology of the input \(Z\).

Scope: This is the formal consequence of the stated translation-cone definition. It does not identify an actual universal critical action space, construct its \(E_2\) structure, or transfer a bracket.

value.statement: At every numerical level, the exact classical ordered augmentation has a continuous right-\(A_0\)-linear strong deformation retraction onto \(A_0\). Its homotopy is defined on arbitrary completed left-valued middle functions, with one middle cutoff and finite algebraic right support on each right quotient.

The cochain homotopy is the negative of the homological matching homotopy. No projective or cofibrant claim in an unspecified topological category follows.

hypotheses: Every numerical level; the inverse-antipode product has the prescribed \(A_yA_x\) order and right evaluation uses \(U\otimes U^r\).
The projector lies outside the cyclic image. Cyclic, Ward-restricted, derived and finite-prodiagram alternatives are not excluded.

value.title: The classical germ map has its own full carrier
value.statement: At every numerical level, the independent classical ordered carrier has a continuous dg full-\(A_0\)-bimodule germ map with kernel \(Y^0(v,u)j(\beta)\). At fixed \(K\ne-2\), the classical reduction of the pure evaluation is homotopic to this map relative to the scalar and every first root, with both Ward laws.
hypotheses: Completed left values, one ghost cutoff and finite right support per slice are retained. The restricted Laurent version has one whole-series floor and constant \(A_0\) endpoints.
The relative Ward equation includes the source Laurent derivative for nonconstant source coefficients.

value.title: A different classical trace square has a nonzero defect
value.statement: On the independent free algebraic trace bimodule with \(dr=J_I(0)e-eJ_I(0)\), the relative route and the germ route differ by a nonzero class in the actual full trace-recipient Hom complex, detected by \(+\mathrm{id}\). A higher-order correction cannot repair a comparison required to reduce to this same fixed square.
hypotheses: Each fixed numerical \(K\ne-2\); algebraic inserted and rooted states; the polynomial marked carrier or its restricted Laurent extension has a common floor, ghost cutoff and finite right support per right slice and inserted input.
The source is independently free; no injection into a finite-expression subcomplex is assumed. This square is distinct from the \(-\mathrm{id}\) coefficient-restriction comparison.

value.title: Finite input currying retains the actual relative chain maps
value.statement: Finite free constant first inputs curry through every ordered slot, pointwise Hom and the outer finite-word sum. The resulting inverse finite-input diagram has literal \(\kappa\) chain maps, finite inverse-antipode linear comparison squares and a corrected unit-relative chain section. These first-order comparisons act on literal quotients modulo \(\hbar^2\).
hypotheses: Four colours and all trace modes are retained over \(R_3=\mathbb C[\hbar]/(\hbar^3)\), with exact RTT-pullback module quotients and the stated ordered topology.
Every numerical level. The finite input is constant here; the separate native dg-input theorem supplies its nonzero differential. No unrestricted loop-cutoff limit is inferred.

value.title: Whole mixed transport retains terms lost by transporting only the correction
value.statement: The whole marked evaluation \(\mathcal E=\mathcal P+\mathcal J+\Xi\) has explicit bare mixed transport through \(R_2\), including the positive \(\mathcal J\) contribution. Its \(R_3\) projection retains both ordered cross paths, the created inserted factor and native first-order lower terms. The two stated vacuum tests stabilize for each finite Cartan cutoff \(M\ge1\) on their specified rooted input.
hypotheses: Each fixed numerical \(K\ne-2\); algebraic inserted and rooted states; the polynomial marked carrier or its restricted Laurent extension has a common floor, ghost cutoff and finite right support per right slice and inserted input.

Existing scalar agreement is with its fixed singleton-coordinate cyclic field and typed coefficient-product maps. Whole physical marked normalization, tensorators and product comparison remain separate.

value.title: The raw left-ideal topology gives an intrinsic word completion
value.statement: Completion by all homogeneous left ideals open in the original nested coefficient topology gives a degreewise native rooted algebra with associative continuous multiplication, differential and translation. It admits the specified growing-length trace series and a continuous unital dg projection onto the full smooth native algebra \(A\), with a continuous unital \(R_3\)-linear section.
hypotheses: Four colours and all trace modes are retained over \(R_3=\mathbb C[\hbar]/(\hbar^3)\), with exact RTT-pullback module quotients and the stated ordered topology.
Every fixed numerical level. The section is linear; no inverse, quasi-isomorphism or physical target comparison follows merely from surjectivity.

value.title: Sampling the inserted unit gives another marked evaluation
value.statement: At fixed \(K\ne-2\), \(\mathcal E_{\rm samp,ten}=\widehat f\,p_{\rm ins,0}+\Xi\) is a continuous dg full-\(A\)-bimodule map on the existing polynomial and restricted Laurent carriers. It preserves both Ward laws, the scalar and all tensor pure-root values. Its complete finite-word classical shuffle square has an actual bimodule homotopy relative to scalar and first-root values.
hypotheses: Each fixed numerical \(K\ne-2\); algebraic inserted and rooted states; the polynomial marked carrier or its restricted Laurent extension has a common floor, ghost cutoff and finite right support per right slice and inserted input.

Sampling commutes with the finite and global Cartan frames. It removes positive inserted trace and \(q/\omega\) coefficient values; the old and sampled maps are not homotopic. The classical source consists of finite words and finite exterior lists.

value.title: The sampled evaluation loses actual cohomology classes
value.statement: The sampled map kills a cubic source cycle generating a split free cohomology summand and the independent classes from every finite family of distinct nonrepeating trace exterior lists. These are nonzero classes in the actual ordered source, transported by the finite and global frames. Hence this particular sampled map is not a quasi-isomorphism, and a homotopy of it cannot restore injectivity.
hypotheses: Each fixed numerical \(K\ne-2\); algebraic inserted and rooted states; the polynomial marked carrier or its restricted Laurent extension has a common floor, ghost cutoff and finite right support per right slice and inserted input.

The same source-local conclusion holds at its stated \(R_2\) and \(R_3\) scopes without assuming cohomology base change. Only a physical comparison requiring this map to detect those classes is excluded.

value.title: Ward identities do not supply an ordinary source transpose
value.statement: An explicit normalized homogeneous trace cochain in the original \(W_{\rightarrow}^{0,2}\) satisfies both actual Ward identities. Its compatible finite raw transposes are closed and Cartan-fixed, but have no coefficient-preserving ordinary value in the exact ordered source or its uniform-Laurent target.
hypotheses: Four colours and all trace modes are retained over \(R_3=\mathbb C[\hbar]/(\hbar^3)\), with exact RTT-pullback module quotients and the stated ordered topology.
Every numerical level, through \(R_3\) on finite coefficients. The obstruction retains the original source and target bounds; it does not rule out all alternative transpose domains.

value.title: Actual native dg inputs have finite graded right duals
value.statement: For every numerical \(K\) over \(R_2\), the transported windows \(U_a^F=F(U_a^0)\) are finite free dg inputs with a strict level-zero loop action, genuine graded right evaluation and coevaluation, and the finite inverse-antipode comparison. The full Hom differential and the frame square are retained.
hypotheses: The windows are exhaustive algebraic native inputs. They lie in underlying weights at most \(a+1\); translation lands in \(U_{a+1}^F\), requiring underlying weights at most \(a+2\).
Output/source consequences are linear chain maps on literal \(R_3/\hbar^2R_3\) quotient complexes. A strict transported input action does not supply a strict output or rooted action.
For a pure current state, \(Fv=v+\frac12\hbar(K+2)T_V^\circ v\); the trace-free translation changes the scalar comparison and cannot be discarded.

value.title: The coefficient source now carries the actual native state differential
value.statement: The pointwise Hom coefficient source on the actual native state complex has the all-source Cartan frame, literal \(\kappa/\Gamma\) square, full unit-relative map and compatible enlarged-stage finite-input diagram through \(R_3\). Restriction along the prescribed \(j_\hbar:B\to M\) is dg and degreewise surjective, with kernel \(\operatorname{Hom}(M/j_\hbar B,K[1])[-1]\).
hypotheses: Four colours and all trace modes are retained over \(R_3=\mathbb C[\hbar]/(\hbar^3)\), with exact RTT-pullback module quotients and the stated ordered topology.
Every numerical level for the source maps; optional marked evaluation only at fixed \(K\ne-2\). Each algebraic input has finite word support, but its bound may vary with the input.
The graded section retains its differential defect; the restriction kernel is not asserted acyclic. Differential and translation use enlarged windows, not frozen native weight quotients.
The separate derived \(j_\hbar\) action comparison remains conditional. It is unnecessary for the established source and restriction statements.

value.title: A fixed Verma source has finite extension support
value.statement: For every simple \(\mathfrak g\) and shifted level \(s\notin\mathbb Q\), a fixed horizontal affine Verma has nonzero actual smooth Ext to only finitely many target-weight and nonnegative-energy pairs, with a finite source-dependent degree bound. At every real \(s>0\), a uniform bound over its targets is \(\dim\mathfrak b+\lfloor\|\operatorname{Re}\lambda+\rho\|^2/(2s)\rfloor\).
hypotheses: Both homogeneous graded and actual ungraded smooth module Ext are included. The source highest weight is arbitrary complex; the degree bound need not be uniform as that source varies.
These are necessary support conditions, not assertions that every allowed Ext group is nonzero.

value.title: The changing-Verma positive-shift telescope vanishes
value.statement: Under the native hypotheses, every countable telescope of the perfect Verma preimages with strictly increasing total cohomological shifts is zero for \(s\in\mathbb C\setminus\mathbb Q_{\le0}\), allowing varying highest weights, arbitrary internal shifts and arbitrary successive maps.
hypotheses: The prescribed coherent native right action, actual smooth tensor–Hom adjunction, exact affine-free lifts and cutoff compatibility remain hypotheses. The graded and ungraded native realizations are supplied separately.

The native transfer also assumes the actual unit and full smooth/algebraic comparison on the common-lower-energy subcategories; these hypotheses are not replaced by an arbitrary unbounded Hom formula.
Both grading conventions are included, without a common energy bound. This is a theorem about this telescope class, not a global-unit argument.

value.title: Verma-generated objects miss the regular horizontal top
value.statement: At every level, the localizing category generated by affine Vermas and their internal shifts is a proper subcategory of the category generated by \(W\). Cartan-local finiteness persists throughout the former, whereas the regular \(U(\mathfrak g)\) top of \(W\) violates it.
hypotheses: The recipient assertion is representation-theoretic, in graded and ungraded conventions. The separate line-source consequence requires the native tensor comparison.

value.title: Every unbounded smooth complex has an explicit injective replacement
value.statement: An actual acyclic-monomorphism cell construction iterated through \(\omega_1\) gives a strict ordinary functor \(J\) and a natural monomorphic quasi-isomorphism \(M\to J(M)\). Every term of \(J(M)\) is injective and the whole complex is K-injective, so full \(\operatorname{Hom}_A(X,J(M))\) computes ordinary smooth derived Hom for arbitrary unbounded \(X,M\).
hypotheses: Graded and ungraded smooth categories use their actual Hom conventions. The replacement functor is ordinary, not asserted dg-enriched.
Under the separate native inputs, the fixed strict right-module model supplies the native Hom action and signed unit; applying \(J\) alone does not create that action.

value.title: The ordinary unit fails at every integral affine level at most minus four
value.statement: For \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) at raw affine level \(-p-2\), \(p\ge2\), a telescope of perfect Verma preimages gives \(L_p\ne0\) with \(\Phi_pL_p=0\). The actual ordinary unit is \(L_p\to0\), with nonzero cone \(L_p[1]\). An infinite-projection map entirely within the generated recipient also proves that \(W_p\) is not compact there.
hypotheses: The prescribed coherent native right action, actual smooth tensor–Hom adjunction, exact affine-free lifts and cutoff compatibility remain hypotheses. The graded and ungraded native realizations are supplied separately.

The native transfer also assumes the actual unit and full smooth/algebraic comparison on the common-lower-energy subcategories; these hypotheses are not replaced by an arbitrary unbounded Hom formula.

Ordinary unbounded derived categories with ordinary coefficient quasi-isomorphisms; internal weights are algebraic sums of arbitrary support. No cohomological, common energy or finite-dimensionality bound is imposed.

The actual normalized Ext-one classes have every finite initial Yoneda product nonzero. The conclusions hold graded and ungraded. The family does not cover shifted level \(-1\) or negative nonintegral rational levels.

value.title: Every simple type has a noncritical unit kernel at a specified level
value.statement: For every nonzero simple complex \(\mathfrak g\) at raw affine level \(-2h^\vee\), an explicit affine-Weyl ascent chain gives an ordinary line telescope \(L\ne0\) with \(\Phi L=0\). Its actual unit has cone \(L[1]\ne0\). The same construction proves failure of compactness of \(W\) within its own localizing image.
hypotheses: The prescribed coherent native right action, actual smooth tensor–Hom adjunction, exact affine-free lifts and cutoff compatibility remain hypotheses. The graded and ungraded native realizations are supplied separately.

The native transfer also assumes the actual unit and full smooth/algebraic comparison on the common-lower-energy subcategories; these hypotheses are not replaced by an arbitrary unbounded Hom formula.

Ordinary unbounded derived categories with ordinary coefficient quasi-isomorphisms; internal weights are algebraic sums of arbitrary support. No cohomological, common energy or finite-dimensionality bound is imposed.
This is one specified noncritical level in every simple type, including nonsimplylaced types. It uses same-type extension products, and does not assert failure at every noncritical level.

value.title: The regular top has disjoint positive-weight central supports
value.statement: For affine \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\), \(s=\ell+2\ne0\), positive-weight smooth self-Ext of \(W\) has \(\Omega_L-\Omega_R=2sw\) and right annihilator \(Q_w(T)=\prod_{m=1}^w[(2sw-2m^2)^2-4m^2(2T+1)]\). At \(s\notin\mathbb Q\), all positive-weight left supports are disjoint from all positive-weight right supports; the resulting module-level Tor groups vanish.
hypotheses: The actual regular \(U(\mathfrak{sl}_2)\) top and its source-precomposition/target-postcomposition actions are used. Fixed-weight amplitude is finite; no common all-weight amplitude bound is asserted.
This representation-theoretic theorem requires no native adjunction. Passing to the actual native ideal is a separate derived theorem.

value.title: A derived square-zero ideal reduces every source to two inflated complexes
value.statement: Let \(B\to R\) be a split augmented dg algebra, K-flat over \(R\) on both sides, with ideal \(I\) satisfying \(I\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}I=0\). For \(F=R\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}-\), inflation \(U\), and \(J=R\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}I\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}R\), every unbounded \(L\) has a natural triangle \(U(J\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}F(L))\to L\to UF(L)\). For any exact adjunction out of \(D(B)\), its actual unit is globally invertible exactly when it is invertible on every inflated \(R\)-complex.
hypotheses: Ordinary algebraic direct sums and unbounded derived tensors are used, in either grading convention. The middle arrow is the actual extension-of-scalars unit.
Derived tensor vanishing is stronger than square-zero multiplication. No unrestricted coproduct preservation by a right adjoint is assumed.

value.title: The actual nonrational rank-one ideal has zero derived tensor square
value.statement: For \(B=Y_{-s}\), \(\mathfrak g=\mathfrak{sl}_2\) and \(s\notin\mathbb Q\), the actual positive-weight ideal \(I=\bigoplus_{w>0}B_w\) satisfies \(I\otimes_{U(\mathfrak{sl}_2)}^{\mathbf L}I\simeq0\), retaining both outer actions in the graded and ungraded bimodule categories.
hypotheses: The prescribed coherent native right action, actual smooth tensor–Hom adjunction, exact affine-free lifts and cutoff compatibility remain hypotheses. The graded and ungraded native realizations are supplied separately.
The exact supported graded unit on the free object \(B\) and the prescribed strict smooth right-module model are retained inputs.
The supported generator unit identifies the correctly oriented native bimodule structure. Finite-weight derived annihilator powers and algebraic coproducts establish the full ideal assertion.

value.title: Restricted positive-current cofree modules are genuinely injective
value.statement: For \(\mathfrak n=t\mathfrak{sl}_2[t]\) over \(\mathbb C\) or \(\mathbb C((q))\), its restricted finite-energy cofree module \(C\) has \(C\otimes T\) injective in the actual smooth positive-current category for every coefficient vector space \(T\). The assertion also holds in the algebraically graded category with arbitrary coefficient-weight support.
hypotheses: The current action is on \(C\) alone and every element has finite cofree support. This is not affine injectivity, a restricted affine-coinduction adjunction, or by itself an arbitrary-complex K-injectivity assertion.

value.title: The actual unit is invertible on every inflated base complex
value.statement: For \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\), native \(k\notin\mathbb Q\) and raw affine level \(\ell=-k-2\), the actual native unit is an equivalence on every ordinary unbounded complex inflated from the full ghost quotient \(H=U(\mathfrak g[t^{-1}])\), hence from \(R=U(\mathfrak g)\). The signed unit evaluates at the vacuum to the identity under the genuine unbounded Shapiro comparison.
hypotheses: The prescribed coherent native right action, actual smooth tensor–Hom adjunction, exact affine-free lifts and cutoff compatibility remain hypotheses. The graded and ungraded native realizations are supplied separately.

Ordinary unbounded derived categories with ordinary coefficient quasi-isomorphisms; internal weights are algebraic sums of arbitrary support. No cohomological, common energy or finite-dimensionality bound is imposed.

The cofree factor remains an algebraic sum. The proof uses the fixed coherent smooth right-module model and positive-current injectivity, without extending a bounded cochain formula to arbitrary inputs.

value.title: Nonrational rank-one induction is fully faithful on the entire ordinary source
value.statement: For \(\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb C)\), native \(k\in\mathbb C\setminus\mathbb Q\) and raw affine level \(\ell=-k-2\), the actual unit \(L\to\Psi\Phi L\) is an equivalence for every ordinary unbounded \(Y_k\)-module, including nonzero ghost actions. The actual realization is fully faithful with image exactly \(\operatorname{Loc}(W)\), or \(\operatorname{Loc}\{W\langle w\rangle:w\in\mathbb Z\}\) in the graded convention.
hypotheses: The prescribed coherent native right action, actual smooth tensor–Hom adjunction, exact affine-free lifts and cutoff compatibility remain hypotheses. The graded and ungraded native realizations are supplied separately.
The exact supported graded unit on the free object \(B\) and the prescribed strict smooth right-module model are retained inputs.

Ordinary unbounded derived categories with ordinary coefficient quasi-isomorphisms; internal weights are algebraic sums of arbitrary support. No cohomological, common energy or finite-dimensionality bound is imposed.

The derived native ideal theorem, the full-domain reduction and the actual all-inflated unit are combined with their exact maps. The image is not asserted to be every smooth object or every object with torsion cohomology.

value.title: The actual counit is the cellular approximation at nonrational rank one
value.statement: Under the same nonrational \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) native hypotheses, \(W\) and its required internal shifts are compact within the generated image. For every unrestricted smooth target \(M\), the actual counit \(\Phi\Psi M\to M\) is canonically the cellular-coreflector map \(\operatorname{Cell}_W M\to M\); it is invertible exactly on that image.
hypotheses: The prescribed coherent native right action, actual smooth tensor–Hom adjunction, exact affine-free lifts and cutoff compatibility remain hypotheses. The graded and ungraded native realizations are supplied separately.
The exact supported graded unit on the free object \(B\) and the prescribed strict smooth right-module model are retained inputs.

Ordinary unbounded derived categories with ordinary coefficient quasi-isomorphisms; internal weights are algebraic sums of arbitrary support. No cohomological, common energy or finite-dimensionality bound is imposed.

Compactness is relative to the localizing image, not to the entire smooth derived category. The positive-weight ideal in the line algebra differs from the positive-current augmentation ideal used for cellularization.

value.title: One nilpotent current has an exact unbounded torsion comparison
value.statement: For \(x=at\) with nonzero ad-nilpotent \(a\), smooth Ore localization \(L_x\) is exact and \(i_xR\Gamma_xM\simeq\operatorname{fib}(M\to L_xM)\) on every ordinary unbounded smooth complex. The inclusion of the derived \(x\)-torsion category is fully faithful, with exactly \(x\)-torsion cohomology as image.
hypotheses: Every nonzero finite-dimensional simple complex Lie algebra and every affine level, graded and ungraded. No native adjunction hypothesis is needed.

value.title: A finite nilpotent basis detects joint torsion
value.statement: A nilpotent basis \(a_i\) of \(\mathfrak g\), with \(x_i=a_it\), gives \(\mathcal T_I=\bigcap_i\ker L_{x_i}\) and \(D_I=\bigcap_i\ker DL_{x_i}\). These exact detectors characterize joint torsion and its cohomological category.
hypotheses: Every simple complex Lie algebra and every affine level. These equalities do not identify the intrinsic derived torsion category with its ambient cohomological category.

value.title: The single-current localizations do not preserve each other’s torsion
value.statement: At every affine \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) level, an explicit smooth module is \(ft\)-torsion while its localization at \(et\) is not. Thus iterating the single-current detectors is not automatically a construction of joint derived torsion.
hypotheses: The graded and ungraded examples are actual smooth affine modules. This obstruction to a chosen construction does not refute the joint comparison.

value.title: Positive-current torsion is stable under injective envelopes
value.statement: The smooth positive-current category is locally noetherian, and joint augmentation torsion is stable under injective envelopes. Finite nilpotent Rees algebras and the resulting Artin–Rees statement give the actual stability theorem on every smooth cyclic module.
hypotheses: Every nonzero finite-dimensional simple complex Lie algebra. Affine injective stability is not inferred merely by restriction.

value.title: Actual derived torsion commutes with positive-current restriction
value.statement: Exact induction on the smooth and torsion categories yields \(\operatorname{Res}_{\mathcal T}R\Gamma_A\simeq R\Gamma_{\mathfrak n}\operatorname{Res}_{\mathcal S}\) on every ordinary unbounded complex, with the actual units and counits. Restriction is conservative; every torsion affine module is \(\Gamma_A\)-acyclic, so \(\Gamma_A\) is weakly stable.
hypotheses: Every simple complex Lie algebra and every affine level. The derived functors use genuine K-injective replacements; no unrestricted continuous-cochain model is substituted.

value.title: Positive-current derived torsion has infinite cohomological dimension
value.statement: For \(R_N=U(\mathfrak n/\mathfrak n_N)\) with its inflated regular action, the first nonzero derived torsion lies in degree \(d_N=(N-1)\dim\mathfrak g\). Its invariant line has energy \(\Delta_N=\dim(\mathfrak g)N(N-1)/2\). These degrees are unbounded.
hypotheses: This is an actual smooth positive-current calculation for every nonzero simple complex Lie algebra. Infinite cohomological dimension alone does not decide the joint derived embedding.

value.title: Positive-current derived torsion fails to preserve a countable coproduct
value.statement: For the shifted regular quotients \(R_N[d_N]\), the actual comparison \(\bigoplus_N R\Gamma(R_N[d_N])\to R\Gamma(\bigoplus_N R_N[d_N])\) has a nonzero degree-zero defect containing \(\mathbb C^{\mathbb N}/\mathbb C^{(\mathbb N)}\). An actual acyclic complex of injectives \(K\) realizes the defect: \(R\Gamma K=0\) but termwise \(\Gamma K\) is not acyclic.
hypotheses: Every nonzero simple complex Lie algebra in the ordinary smooth positive-current category. In the algebraically graded version, the individual shift \(\langle-\Delta_N\rangle\) places all diagonal classes in energy zero.

The proof uses genuine K-injective products and the actual comparison map. It does not transfer an affine coproduct failure by restriction, or by itself decide the joint derived embedding or equality with cellularization.

value.title: A bare exterior E3 algebra has no coupling parameter
value.statement: A strictly unital \(E_3\)-algebra over \(\mathbb C\) with cohomology \(\Lambda(x_3)\), \(|x_3|=3\), is unique up to equivalence at the level of its bare \(E_3\) structure. That structure alone therefore supplies no varying coupling scalar. A filtration, mixed action, retained translation or central-charge class, marked comparison, or braided category is additional data.
hypotheses: This is single-generator exterior rigidity. It is not a rigidity theorem for arbitrary simple affine cohomology, and uniqueness does not construct an enhancement on a separately prescribed object.
Rank-one coefficient Koszul comparisons retain their specified unipotent sector and separate charge grading; no full all-charge braided equivalence follows from bare formality.

value.title: The critical translation cone retains kernel and cokernel data
value.statement: For the two-term translation object \(z_{\rm top}=\operatorname{fib}(T:Z\to Z)\), its cohomology fits into \(0\to\operatorname{coker}(T:H^{n-1}Z\to H^{n-1}Z)\to H^n(z_{\rm top})\to\ker(T:H^nZ\to H^nZ)\to0\). At critical level it cannot simply be identified with the oper-form cohomology of the input \(Z\).
hypotheses: This is the formal consequence of the stated translation-cone definition. It does not identify an actual universal critical action space, construct its \(E_2\) structure, or transfer a bracket.
